name: Covert Carry
description: Carrying physical access tools covertly requires attention to both concealment and detectability. Standard steel picks are ferromagnetic and will trigger metal detector portals and handheld wand searches. Titanium picks are non-ferrous and do not trigger standard magnetic metal detection. The covert pocket belt provides a concealed carry option for pick sets that passes casual visual inspection. Equipment loadout should be calibrated to the expected security screening environment for each engagement.

blue.det: Metal detector or X-ray screening may detect ferrous tools; visual inspection may reveal tool outlines; non-ferrous picks pass metal detectors.
blue.cm: Metal detector portals and wand screening at entry; X-ray of bags and equipment; pat-down for high-security areas; non-ferrous picks (titanium, aluminum) bypass metal detection — physical pat-down required.
